Palermo panelle.d: Chickpea fritters with parsley, fried crisp. Salt and a squeeze of lemon.
Palermo panelle.note: Served in the foyer before curtain.

Prosciutto and melon.d: Ripe cantaloupe, cured ham, cracked pepper and olive oil.

Pasta alla Norma.d: Rigatoni, fried eggplant, tomato and basil, under grated ricotta salata.
Pasta alla Norma.note: Atto unico: the supper in the Ridotto.

Opera night cannoli.d: Crisp shells filled to order with sweet ricotta, candied orange, pistachio.
Opera night cannoli.note: Boxed with care, sent up to your palco.

Teatro Massimo limoncello spritz.d: Lemon liqueur on ice, prosecco and soda, lemon peel and mint.
Teatro Massimo limoncello spritz.note: Poured in the foyer before Cavalleria rusticana.
